rationale: We eliminate the -$9,500 cash deficit by breaking the Day 13 land expansion ceiling, extending contiguous plot scaling to 28-34 plots across 10-11 hired hands through Day 17 to fully utilize workforce capacity and compound 3+ late-game harvest flushes. We abolish the blanket post-Day 5 slow crop ban by establishing a dynamic 3-5 plot Contract ROI Dispatch for high-premium (>= 2.2x) town shop orders, while calibrating capital velocity floors to 0.80x standard / 0.76x midday reinvestment to prevent early cash starvation. Finally, we integrate watering can well refills directly into the shed drop-off transit loop, eliminating mid-field travel thrashing and guaranteeing 100% can capacity for seamless in-situ harvest-and-water cycles.
